headline: 劇場新作:夢露與紐約
context: 兩則劇場圈的新消息。英國萊斯特Curve劇院明年秋天將推出新音樂劇《Misfits Together》，描寫瑪麗蓮夢露（Marilyn Monroe）與劇作家亞瑟・米勒（Arthur Miller）的婚姻，由樂團Bastille主唱丹・史密斯（Dan Smith）操刀作曲。另一邊，紐約公共劇院找來一群紐約市民，在中央公園打造一場現場音樂會，向這座城市致敬。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Misfits Together, by Bastille’s Dan Smith and To Kill a King’s Ralph Pelleymounter, is set amid the 1950s’ ‘red scare’ It was lampooned as the union of the “hourglass” and the “egghead” – the marriage, in the summer of 1956, between Hollywood superstar Marilyn Monroe and Pulitzer-winning playwright Arthur Miller. Now, a new stage musical is to give a nuanced and intimate portrait of that famous relationship, treat each as trailblazers in their own way and reveal parallels between the volatile state of the US during the 50s “red scare” and now. The production, which opens next autumn at Leicester’s Curve , is called Misfits Together, a reference to the film Miller wrote for Monroe that was released shortly after their divorce in 1961. It is a foray into musical theatre by two indie musicians, Dan Smith of the band Bastille and Ralph Pelleymounter from To Kill a King, who have recorded the score as a studio album. The first track, Oh America, is out on Thursday. Continue reading...
sources.title: New musical to give intimate portrait of Marilyn Monroe and Arthur Miller’s marriage

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: In an ambitious new project, a cast of New Yorkers will help to create a one-of-a-kind tribute to New York City on stage in Central Park Last year, theatre-makers Emily Lim and Dan Canham spent time in Sunderland developing a three-night live performance that sought to capture the north-east city’s essence and history through music, dance and spoken word. It was Lim’s final coup as the director of the National Theatre’s now defunct, UK-wide community programme, Public Acts, and the result was Public Record – a title that nods to both physical media (the audio is stored at the British Library and Sunderland Museum) and to the institutional archive. “It’s very full-circle,” Lim says, now doing the same for New York City’s Public Theatre, whose own Public Works branch inspired the National’s initiative. “The key difference is that instead of serving the country and national profile, our responsibility here is to serve the city.” Continue reading...
sources.title: ‘The myth is constantly being told’: creating a live album on stage as tribute to New York

thread_text:

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 3 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
劇場圈有兩則新消息。英國萊斯特的Curve劇院，明年秋天將推出新音樂劇《Misfits Together》，描寫瑪麗蓮夢露（Marilyn Monroe）與劇作家亞瑟・米勒（Arthur Miller）在1950年代「紅色恐慌」氛圍下的婚姻，由樂團Bastille主唱丹・史密斯（Dan Smith）與To Kill a King的拉爾夫・佩勒蒙特（Ralph Pelleymounter）共同創作。另一頭，紐約公共劇院找來一群紐約市民，在中央公園打造一場現場音樂會，向這座城市致敬，這項計畫延續了劇場人艾蜜莉・林（Emily Lim）先前在英國桑德蘭完成的類似作品。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 3 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 劇場圈今天有兩則新消息。第一則，英國明年秋天要推出一齣新音樂劇，講的是瑪麗蓮夢露和劇作家亞瑟・米勒的婚姻，背景設定在1950年代的紅色恐慌年代，作曲的是樂團Bastille的主唱。另一則，紐約公共劇院找來一群紐約市民，要在中央公園辦一場現場音樂會，向這座城市致敬。
